description: Listed building consent for conversion an existing dilapidated barn into residential accommodation associated with Osterley Park Farmhouse
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( OFHB-PR-03C, OFHB-PR-04C received 6 July 2021; Energy Statement 20 April 2021 received 20 April 2021; OFHB-EX-01, OFHB-EX-02, Heritage and design and access statements and flood risk assessment received 15 February 2021 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Before any work starts on site the developer shall first carry out a full survey of the materials and construction of the existing building and produce a schedule indicating all materials and structural elements to be saved in situ or to be carefully removed, stored and re-used (including a method and proposal for their removal, storage and re-use on site) and of all materials that are to be disposed of and shall submit this to the local planning authority.  No work shall start until the details submitted have been approved and the works shall conform to the approved schedule and methods.
Condition : 4 - The existing materials used on the external surfaces of the building shall be carefully removed and stored at the outset of the development works where necessary and shall be re-used to clad the finished structure.  Any materials that need to be added or replaced to make good shortfalls shall match the existing in type, colour, dimensions, texture and coursing and (in the case of brickwork) the mortar used shall be lime mortar formulated to ensure that future damage to the brickwork shall not arise as a result of any necessary re-pointing.
Condition : 5 - No work shall start until a schedule giving details of all new materials (internal and external) and all proposed external finishes (including joinery details, colour, texture, composition, coursing, face bond and pointing and staining and paint finishes) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and the details so approved shall be implemented.
Condition : 6 - No new plumbing, pipes, soil stacks, flues, vents, grills, security alarms or ductwork shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the drawings hereby approved External ironmongery, guttering and pipework shall be iron steel or aluminium and shall be painted black
